decisions.session_length: 2 or 3 turns remain development candidates; retain a meaningfully contextual 3+ turn cohort. Final allocation not selected.
decisions.min_facts: No fixed four-fact requirement; reviewer suggestion remains an unvalidated heuristic.
decisions.heading_only: Do not categorically reject heading evidence; mark and stratify, assess whether question remains meaningful.
decisions.evidence_insufficient: Keep accepted variants as model suggestions only; flag consecutive absence questions for naturalness adjudication, do not require every family to be context-dependent.
decisions.weak_cross_document: Flag shared-topic pair as weak; exclude from strong-synthesis claims until relationship/quality adjudication; retain as candidate for possible separate retrieval analysis.
decisions.dependency: Seven reference labels are reviewer judgments and do not establish causal need for history or measured fusion usage.
decisions.near_duplicate: Existing SimHash diagnostic found no matches; source/event semantic independence remains unverified.

remaining: Human/independent content adjudication for revised questions, evidence-insufficient naturalness and weak pair.
Assess contextual dependence using history-ablation design and disclose actual Session coverage if run.
Group same-source, near-duplicate and same-event dependencies before selecting and statistically analyzing cohorts.
Record actual lengths, per-family counts, exclusion reasons and protocol change after these decisions; T10-D remains unstarted.
